verdict.rationale: Conductor's cloud workspaces keep running after you close your laptop. They are shared at the organization level, so the same workspace and conversation can be reopened and resumed from another Conductor client. That makes cross-machine continuation plausible, but the docs frame it as teammate handoff rather than one user switching devices, and they never mention a browser client. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the same user resuming a task on a second device, any browser/web access to workspaces, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser

citations.quote: Sandboxes spin up in seconds, and agents keep working after you close your laptop.
Workspaces and chats are shared with your organization, so a teammate can open the same workspace, follow the same conversation, and pick up where you left off.
The link opens the workspace in Conductor for any member of the organization.
